description: Every administrative boundary containing a point, country first down to the smallest district, plus postcode areas. Use it to tag an address, a store or a delivery with its country, state, county and city in one call. Costs 1 unit. Returns ids you can pass to get_boundary. A point nobody asked about before is looked up in OpenStreetMap; when that is slow or down, the call answers the boundaries already cached with polygons, marked partial: true with retry_after and a hint (city, district or postcode may be missing), or 503 upstream_unavailable with retry_after when none is cached. A slow lookup keeps running, so the same call after retry_after is served complete from the cache. Needs an API key or a connected account.
name: reverse_boundaries
title: Boundaries at a point
